heading: How to Change Amap to English on iPhone & Android
intro: Set the interface language first, then test an English destination search. Amap, also called Gaode Maps, is listed as AMap Global in the official app stores. Menu locations and translated content can differ between phone systems and app versions.
quickAnswer: Amap Global supports English. Update the official app, select English in a first-run language picker if shown, or look for Language (语言 / 语言设置) in the app settings. If that control is missing, check the iPhone or Android app-language options below. An English interface does not translate every business listing: keep your hotel name and address in Chinese and test the exact destination before travel.

sections.title: Choose the official Amap download for your phone
items: Check the app name and publisher before installing. The official iPhone listing names AutoNavi Information Technology Co. Ltd.; the Android package is com.autonavi.minimap. Store availability and app details can vary by region.

sections.title: How to switch Amap to English
items: Update Amap from its official store and open it with a working internet connection.
Choose English if a language picker appears during setup. Otherwise open the app settings and look for Language or Language Settings; use the Chinese labels below if the interface is still Chinese.
Select English if offered, reopen the map and check whether the main controls changed. A particular tab position or menu order is not guaranteed across versions.
If there is no language control, use the phone-specific checks below. Keep a Chinese copy of your destination address while troubleshooting.

sections.title: Chinese menu labels to look for
items: These translations help you recognise controls; they are not a fixed sequence of taps.

sections.title: iPhone: check the app language
items: iOS supports an app language separate from the device language. In iPhone Settings, find the Amap app entry and look for a language preference if your installed version exposes one.
Select English if available, then reopen Amap. The current App Store listing includes English among its supported languages; that does not mean every listing or service screen will be translated.
If the language control is absent, check the in-app picker and official app update rather than assuming you must change your App Store country or download another build.

sections.title: Android: check App languages
items: On supported Android versions, open phone Settings, then System, Languages and App languages. Manufacturer wording can differ; Google notes that some steps require Android 14 or later.
Choose Amap and English only if the app is listed and offers English. Not all apps or installed builds expose this system control.

If the change does not take effect, reopen Amap with a network connection and check for an app update. If Amap is absent from the list, return to its own language settings instead of treating the system menu as a guaranteed fix.

sections.title: If English is missing or Amap is still in Chinese

rows: Verify the official app and update it. Check the in-app picker and your phone-specific options; availability can differ.
Menus are English but a place name is Chinese
Use the Chinese name from the booking. Interface language and individual listing content are different.
English search finds several similar places
Check the city, district, branch, station or airport before choosing a result.
The app asks you to sign in for a service
Treat account setup as a separate step. A language change does not bypass account, payment or service requirements.

faqs.question: How do I change Amap to English?
faqs.answer: Update the official app and choose English in its first-run picker or language settings if offered. Language can appear as 语言 or 语言设置. If the control is missing, check the app-language options on your phone; availability and menu order vary by version.

faqs.question: Can I use Amap in English on iPhone?
faqs.answer: The official Amap Global App Store listing includes English. Check the in-app language picker and the app-specific language preference in iPhone Settings if available, then reopen the app. Individual place names and service screens may still contain Chinese.

faqs.question: How do I change Amap language on Android?
faqs.answer: Try the app language settings first. On supported phones, Settings, System, Languages and App languages is another place to check. This only works when the installed app supports the Android control and lists English; it is not available for every build.

faqs.question: Why is Amap still in Chinese after I choose English?
faqs.answer: Check whether only a place listing is Chinese or the main controls are also unchanged. Reopen the updated app with a working connection and review its language setting. Use the Chinese destination name from your booking while you check; changing the interface does not translate all content.

faqs.question: Can I search Amap using an English address?
faqs.answer: Try the English place name, then confirm its Chinese name, city and exact branch or entrance. If results are missing or ambiguous, paste the Chinese address from the booking. An airport and a railway station can share a district name but be different destinations.
